description: This file defines the React component 'GlobalSidebarLayout' which renders a fixed sidebar navigation menu with toggleable expand/collapse behavior, user profile dropdown, and navigation links for a Next.js application. It handles local storage for sidebar state persistence and includes styling for UI elements.

classes.name: NavItem
classes.description: Type union defining navigation item structure for links and dummy placeholders.

methods.name: GlobalSidebarLayout
methods.description: Main React component implementing the sidebar layout with navigation and profile menu.

methods.name: isActive
methods.description: Determines if a navigation link is active based on current pathname.
